opening.argument: This presentation ties an ETH-earning opportunity to recruitment, payment, and continued participation in a tiered structure. It says, “We can earn ETH from a platform called Forsage,” while describing X3 income through direct referrals and X4 income through teammates. It further states that “only if your mates are higher, you will get passive income,” making the prospect of income dependent on other participants. Entry requires payment of 0.05 ETH, and the description directs viewers to “Join forsage using the referral.” The speaker also presents an earning-related payment range of 3000 to 3500, identifies Ethereum-based units, and tells interested viewers to contact the number on screen. An opening disclaimer limits responsibility, but it does not remove the recruitment, payment, commission, and potentially continuing referral-income framing.
